for_senior_author: Interpretation gap (reader 2 agrees: substantial): consider adding to 'claimed' that the title and abstract describe lower subcortical metabolism that is lower only after normalizing to the elevated whole-brain value; absolute caudate and putamen values were not lower (new key finding 6).
not_added: Figure 3 footnote c gives one test statistic (t=5.5, p<0.0001) for both thalamus and caudate: confirmed; identical t values are possible and nothing depends on it, so not added.

Whole-brain metabolism correlated negatively with years of use (r=−0.62), opposite to the group difference: already in analysis.effect_sizes; not significant after adjusting for age, so not added as a finding.
Reference 18 cites the companion DAT paper with another title and pages 384–390 (p. 388), and the abstinence ranges differ slightly from Volkow et al. (2001a): confirmed, minor, not added.
